text: Barclays PLC is a UK-listed bank whose only notifiable holder above the 3% disclosure threshold as at 31 December 2025 is BlackRock (about 5.8%). Barclays avoided a UK government stake during the 2008 crisis by raising private capital from Qatari investors instead (unlike RBS and Lloyds), so there is no former state holding to have been sold.

source.name: Barclays PLC Annual Report 2025 (Form 20-F), 'Major shareholders' p.114

additionalSources.name: Simply Wall St (syndicated via Yahoo Finance), "Barclays PLC (LON:BARC) is largely controlled by institutional shareholders who own 80% of the company"
